title: Say panarian ya ag-anengneng so anggaan na soberano
intro: Say awaran et walaan na amin a klase na manuley, balet pigpigara so angidaulo ed sakey a domain a singa saya. No iner so dagem ya mismon oneebat ed ganggan da tan saray trabahador ya anggapoy too ya makanengneng et nansagpot ya mareen, sayan uley et aliwan singa samay akauna odino kayari to. Balet anggan say sankabalgan a panarian et nepeg ya mangangga—tan nen agawa iya, say katuaan et pinmaway manlapud sakey a lapuan ya mapaabeba ya anggapoy anggan sakey ya akaisip ya mansuspetsa ed satan.
clues: Inikdan ak na Katawan ko na malaknab a panarian, ya abitla ed saray sagradon pahina.
Atawir ko so baleg a kakabatan tan autoridad manlapud sakey ya ateng ya akauna nen siak ed debosyon.
Ingganggan ko so mismon dagem, tan sikatoy linma ed arawi parad saray gagala ko.
Saray pinalsan ag nanengneng na ordinaryon mata so nansagpot ed silong na autoridad ko, a nanggawa na saray pakelaw ya agnaparaan.
Saray subol na tinunaw a gansa so onaagus parad siak, sakey a bendisyon ya nikadkaduma ed saray pinili nen Allah.

Nen tinmaynan ak ed sayan mundo, say laman ko et nansiansian akaalagey ed sakey a baston. Nen walay melag a pinalsa ed dalin ya angan ed satan a baston et amoria labat na saramay walad kaliberliber ko ya linmabas ak la.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Propeta Sulaiman (Solomon)
Propeta Dawud (David)
Propeta Musa (Moses)
Propeta Yusuf (Joseph)
Propeta Isa (Jesus)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say patey so imparungtal na sakey a pinalsa ya mangan ed baston ko
Say baleg a delap ya aneral ed saray totook
Say pangibantak ed mandarlang ya apoy
Say inkadestiero ed inapag a dayat
Say sakripisyo na sankamaongan ya anak ko
trial.answer: Say patey so imparungtal na sakey a pinalsa ya mangan ed baston ko

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Saray subol na tinunaw a gansa
Say kaban na sipanan
Sakey a baston ya manbibiigan ed danum
Sakey a manpopoolan a kakiewan
Say balitok a baka
location.answer: Saray subol na tinunaw a gansa

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say jinn et nantultuloy ya nankimey anggad naan so baston
Saray totook so nisalba ed sakey a baleg a barko
Sakey a managpairap so linmereg ed dayat
Sakey a mabiskeg a bansa so dineral na makapataktakot a dagem
Intagey ak ed tawen a mabilay
outcome.answer: Say jinn et nantultuloy ya nankimey anggad naan so baston

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
